title: Data for Posting Results of PSLE Students in UPLIFT Programme
what_it_is: Data for Posting Results of PSLE Students in UPLIFT Programme

sections.label: ComLink+ children school outcomes
sections.summary: In 2023 and 2024, about 70% of ComLink+ families with school-going children had all children attending school regularly and progressing to post-secondary institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: According to the latest available data, in 2023 and 2024, about 70% of ComLink+ families with school-going children had all children attending school regularly and progressing to post-secondary education institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: More detailed data is publicly available in the Ministry of Social and Family Development’s (MSF's) “Supporting Lower-Income Households Trends Report”.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: As ComLink+ was launched recently in 2023, we will need more time to observe trends arising from efforts under ComLink+.

sections.label: MSF data and wrap-around support
sections.summary: The MSF data results from holistic wrap-around support integrating agencies, SSAs, community groups and corporates, with family coaches and school colleagues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The first question he asked is what to make of the data that MSF had put out, which incorporates the enrolment, attendance and the progression outcomes for children from ComLink families who are in school.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: I would say that it is a result of the efforts to provide holistic wrap-around through integration of support from various agencies and SSAs, as well as community groups and corporates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It is more data driven, there is a family coach, there are colleagues in the schools brought in, such as special education needs officers, student welfare officers and so on, better to support the children, but also link up with the agencies and SSAs supporting the family.

sections.label: Community groups, UPLIFT and holistic support
sections.summary: Members can link community groups to ComLink Alliance Working Groups, and UPLIFT support provides holistic development, not only academics.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The second question, if I recall the Member is asking is, that there are community groups that do homework club support and mentoring support, and what more can MOE do to coordinate?

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: I would encourage the Member or all Members who know of these groups to link them up with the ComLink Alliance Working Group in every town where there are rental flats or where there are families supported under ComLink+, there will be an Alliance Working Group.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The Member's third question is whether the support through UPLIFT in our schools that contribute to for the overall ComLink+ efforts nation-wide, whether they support only academics.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: I would say they provide support for the holistic development and enrichment of our children in our schools.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Some of our after-school support does not just cover academic or homework support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: They also provide mentoring, they provide learning journeys, interest-based activities like photography, sports, arts and so on.
